sentences.en: Young people naturally react against the attitudes of their parents.
sentences.zh: 年轻人自然会对父母的态度产生反抗。

sentences.en: People react to the frustration in much the same way.
sentences.zh: 人们对于挫败感的反应大同小异。

sentences.en: I don't know why I reacted the way I did.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我当时为什么会那样反应。

senses.zh: 反应；影响；反抗；起反作用 -
使发生相互作用；使起化学反应
